target_customer: Real estate owners and landlords with multi-property portfolios
problem: Landlords keep large idle reserves and security deposits in bank accounts and leak money on property expenses. Goldbridge offers banking, spend intelligence and automation for property owners.
business_model: Fintech platform: banking accounts with interest, cards, and savings services such as tax appeals and vendor renegotiation; pricing not found
product_category: Banking and finance software for real estate owners

founders.name: Alvin Salehi
previous_startups: Shef (co-founder, homemade food marketplace, reached Series B per the YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Described as a 2x YC founder who owns and operates multifamily properties. Education not listed.

founders.name: Greg Rami
education: Dual master's degrees in computer science and business management (institutions not named)
founders.background_notes: 15+ years in mobile, web and backend engineering.

competitors.name: Baselane
competitors.what: Banking and finance platform for landlords with accounts per property
competitors.traction_then: Launched landlord banking in July 2025 per its own page
competitors.funding_then: Reported $34.4M raised (per a proptech trade post, undated)

competitors.name: Stessa
competitors.what: Banking tools for landlords and investors

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on FDIC-insured partner bank infrastructure with reconciliation and property-level sub-ledgers. Standard fintech engineering with compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Banking relationships create some switching costs, but several landlord banking products already existed and rely on similar banking-as-a-service partners.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: RentSpree announced a landlord banking product in January 2026 per a trade article, showing adjacent players moving into the wedge after the batch.

market_need_then: The launch post cites over $1T in annual rent flowing through landlord accounts and $2.5T of real estate loans maturing in 2027 and 2028, framing owners as eager to raise income. These are company claims.

branding.domain_note: goldbridgebanking.com redirects to trygoldbridge.com. The exact .com was not available.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ramp-style fintech positioning: Ramp for Real Estate

brand_strength.rationale: Only YC pages and one spotlight article mention it. The Ramp comparison borrows credibility but no brand traction evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Goldbridge is an active Fall 2025 company led by a repeat YC founder who owns multifamily property and by a CTO with 15 years of engineering. A spotlight article says it had one pilot customer by June 2026. Competitors in landlord banking already existed. No exit or failure has occurred, and funding is unverified.
notes: Funding: a single article (Runtimewire, 2026-11-08) reports a $9M pre-seed with no investors named, while directories list $500K in 2025-12. Both unverified and conflicting, so no round recorded. Greg Rami is named on the YC page. Searches for outcome news found nothing about this company. The Baselane funding figure is undated.
